The tall conditioned build, chestnut medium-loose wrapped side section, plum-gray short mantle, unarmored tunic, divided lower layers, offset closures, narrow reinforced cuffs, rhythmic color blocking, contrasting boot laces, settled-heel stance, and tally cord are legible. However, the complexion reads materially lighter than band-6-deepest, while the face reads more tapered than full-cheeked and the nose is not distinctly flat and broad.

The cloth mantle, tunic, trousers, boots, closures, laces, and quiet tally cord remain ordinary mortal details; no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text appears.
